airgapDisabled: Updates are unavailable while Airgap Mode is enabled.
cannotUpdateMessage: Factory cannot update from its current location.
configurationUnavailable: Updates are disabled because the deployment configuration could not be read. Restart the app or contact your administrator.
deploymentDisabled: Factory-hosted automatic updates are unavailable for this deployment. Contact your administrator for an approved installer.
downloadFailed: Could not download the update. Please try again.
downloadIncomplete: The update download is incomplete. Please try again.
downloadTooLarge: The update download is too large.
downloadVerificationFailed: The update download failed verification. Please try again.
enterpriseDisabled: Desktop updates are disabled by your organization.
externalInstallDisabled: This copy of Factory is managed outside the in-app updater. Update it with your package manager or reinstall it with the Factory install script.
installBusy: Another install of this app is running. Please wait for it to finish and try again.
installLockFailed: Could not lock the Linux install directory.
moveToApplications: Move Factory.app to your Applications folder, then relaunch it to enable auto-updates.
msixPolicy: Windows could not update Factory. Check your organization’s deployment policy or contact IT. Do not move files out of WindowsApps.
noWriteAccess: Factory does not have write access to its install location. Try running it from a user-writable folder, or launch as Administrator.
notEnoughMemory: Not enough free memory to install the update. Close some apps and try again.
packageTooLarge: The update package is too large to install.
policyChanged: Organization update policy changed. Please try again.
policyUnverified: Unable to verify organization update policy. Please try again.
restartFailed: Could not restart into the update. Please try again.
serverUnreachable: Could not reach update server. Please try again.
userSettingDisabled: Desktop updates are turned off by disableAutoUpdate in your Factory settings (~/.factory/settings.json).
